:::{#exr-prediction-error-residual}
#### Prediction error and residual

For an observation $\iobs$,
write its [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) $\prederr_\iobs$
in terms of its [residual](#def-residual) $\resid_\iobs$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-prediction-error-residual}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\prederr_\iobs
&= \fitted_\iobs - \outvar_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of prediction error)}\\
&= -(\outvar_\iobs - \fitted_\iobs)
&& \text{(factor out $-1$)}\\
&= -\resid_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of residual)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
